<template>
  <div class="greeter" v-if="visible">
    <p>{{ message }}</p>
    <button @click="increment">+1</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: "Greeter",
  data() {
    return {
      visible: true,
      count: 0,
    };
  },
  methods: {
    increment() {
      this.count += 1;
    },
    classify(n) {
      if (n < 0) {
        return "negative";
      } else if (n === 0) {
        return "zero";
      }
      return "positive";
    },
  },
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.greeter {
  color: red;
}
</style>
